snippet.title: Beyond The Plastic Wall - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Beyond The Plastic Wall, an atmospheric, narrative-driven 2D puzzle platformer developed by Motvind Studios. Players will find the location of a mysterious writer within the walls of the last city at the end of the world. Explore a vibrant and stylized world, solve puzzles, and come to terms with the broken things we cannot fix. Beyond The Plastic Wall is coming soon to PC (Steam).
